title: Enterprise onboarding gate & triage checklist for hosted API chat/streaming/toolcalls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a standardized gate and prioritization checklist for incoming enterprise feature requests to the Hosted API team that touch chat, streaming, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. Goal: reduce onboarding cycle time, ensure consistent SLO and compliance evaluations, and provide deterministic escalation paths for features that require Dedicated/Private options or bespoke data-residency handling. This ticket covers the rubric, readiness checklist, escalation triggers, and templates for PM/SE/Eng intake workshops.
triage_rubric: Signal & source: customer-reported (CS/SE) = 3x weight vs anonymous usage; partner proof-of-concept = 2x
Revenue timeframe: committed deal with timeline within 90 days = high; exploratory interest = low
SLO & latency exposure: expected tail-latency >20% of baseline or sustained qps delta = immediate escalation
Data residency / compliance: any request referencing regulated PII/PHI or data residency = require Private/Dedicated assessment
Implementation complexity: changes to public API surface or breaking schema change = higher risk multiplier
Operational cost: expected >25% increase in token cost or GPU hours = prioritize Optimize recommendations or alternate rollout
readiness_checklist: Business case: customer, ARR impact estimate, and committed timeline provided
SLO impact assessment: projected latency and throughput change with benchmarks or model profiles attached
Security & compliance sign-off requested: list of required reviews (legal, infosec, privacy)
Data flow diagram attached: shows ingress/egress, residency and retention policies
API contract draft: OpenAPI snippet or schema for structured outputs and toolcall signatures
Fallback plan: compatible fallback model/route and throttling policy defined
Billing and quota impact: rate limits, billing tiers, and expected monthly usage estimate
Regression test plan: prompt set + metrics for quality preservation (precision/recall/latency)
escalation_triggers: High SLA risk: >5% projected chance of missing latency SLO during peak = escalate to Eng oncall and SRE
Data residency requirement in a new jurisdiction = raise to Legal + Platform Security
Cross-team dependency that blocks >2 sprints for launch = route to PM Leadership for prioritization
Customer committed to launch with financial penalties = escalate to Sales Ops and Exec sponsor
Significant runtime change (kernel/quantization/architecture) required = schedule runtime design review
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use a weighted-scoring approach (signal, revenue, SLO, security) instead of pure FIFO to reduce out-of-band escalations
Trade-off: Strict readiness gates will increase time-to-first-demo for exploratory customers; mitigate by introducing an 'expedited POC lane' with documented risk acceptance
Decision: Requests that require Private deployments due to data residency will follow a separate Dedicated/Private intake flow but must still pass this checklist for initial prioritization
Trade-off: Requiring full API contract up-front may slow intake; accepted in exchange for fewer ambiguous engineering spikes later
acceptance_criteria: Published intake rubric and checklist in Confluence with version and owner
PM intake form updated in Zendesk/Drive with required fields linked to rubric
One cross-functional intake workshop run with SE/Eng/SRE/Legal using three real customer requests as pilots
Dashboard tile in Console for tracking 'enterprise intake throughput' and 'time to readiness' created (minimum viability metrics)
